# Requirements + Design Specification — <project-id>

> Instantiate at `docs/projects/<project-id>/spec.md` for new significant initiatives. The Owner accepts an **exact committed revision** before formal Project Critic. Keep approval references/commit SHAs **outside** this frozen candidate in separate attributable Owner evidence. Routine tasks have no mandatory Spec.

## Initiative identity and provenance

- **Repository and unique stable project ID:** `<owner>/<repo>`, `<project-id>`
- **Initiative intent:** exact Owner request/Issue revision, or optional `docs/projects/<project-id>/intent.md` with provenance
- **Product fit and baseline:** link `PROJECT_BRIEF.md`, actual starting Git commit/tree
- **Users, problem and target outcome:** verifiable, within actual constraints

## Requirements and current evidence

- **Existing behavior / system context:**
- **Required functional and quality behavior:**
- **Affected components, data boundaries and external effects:**
- **Inputs, outputs, interfaces, contracts and constraints:**
- **Security, privacy, operational and downstream assumptions:**
- **In-scope / out-of-scope:**

## Design and material decisions

- **Proposed architecture and design boundaries:**
- **Alternatives, tradeoffs and dependencies:**
- **Applicable adopted ADRs and known risks:**
- **Open questions requiring Owner decision before P:**

## Observable acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-01: <evidence/behavior, not generic intention>
- [ ] AC-02: <evidence/behavior>

## Approval and revision boundary

The separate Owner decision record identifies **repository, exact Spec commit/path/blob**, original intent/decision and accepted scope. No self-referential commit field or mutable “approved” flag is written into this document. Material Spec revision requires new exact Owner acceptance and affected P/Critic/Owner/W gates; old W does not silently rebind to a new Spec.
